subject: Post-call exec recap & next steps  NexaVante
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie.grant@nexavante.com>, Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@nexavante.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-04T15:12:00Z
Subject: Post-call exec recap & next steps  NexaVante

Hi Sophie / Carlos,

Thanks again for carving out time today  appreciated the candid conversation. Quick executive recap from our side and proposed next steps so leadership has a single source of truth.

Key business outcomes you called out
- Reduce turnaround time for patient-care summarization by ~60% to free clinicians for higher-value tasks.
- Achieve consistent structured outputs for downstream billing automation (save ~2 FTEs / month).
- Maintain PHI controls and on-prem/VPC options for regulatory/compliance needs.

Primary pain points discussed
- Current vendor struggles with tail-latency during peak hours causing clinician workflow disruption.
- Lack of consistent structured outputs (JSON schema) across encounter types.
- Concern about onboarding timeline and legal/security documentation.

Redwood value alignment
- Dedicated inference pools for predictable latency at scale (SLA-backed).
- Structured-output support + function calling to map to your billing schema.
- Private deployment option + audit logs/KMS integrations for PHI workloads.

Procurement & timeline (what we heard)
- You indicated leadership is targeting a pilot in June with a narrow scope (ED summaries) and evaluation window of 6-8 weeks.
- Procurement expects an initial purchasing approval in late May; security/compliance review running concurrently.

Open risks / escalation items
- Legal needs an example DPA + data flow diagram (we can share our redline-friendly DPA + SOC 2 evidence).
- Security requested an architecture diagram showing VPC/on-prem options and key rotation process.
- Potential executive concern if pilot latency exceeds 300ms P95 on typical ED loads.

Proposed next steps (owner / ETA)
- Shared docs: I attached the mutual action plan + Redwood overview for your leadership (see attachments). (Marissa)  today
- Schedule pilot scoping session with engineering + infra to lock telemetry & success metrics (Aditya)  by 2027-04-09
- Intro to procurement/legal to surface licensing model and timeline (Marissa + Laura)  by 2027-04-12
- Provide SOC 2 and security pack; start security Q&A (Security pack link attached)  by 2027-04-09

If this aligns, I'll loop in our solutions architect and legal with the MAP and draft SOW for pilot scope. Thanks again  happy to jump on a short call with Carlos or the procurement team if helpful.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182

Attachments: Redwood-MA-Overview.pdf, Nexavante-Mutual-Action-Plan.xlsx

From: Sophie Grant <sophie.grant@nexavante.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@nexavante.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@nexavante.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call exec recap & next steps  NexaVante

Marissa  thanks for the clear recap, this is very helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Pilot scope: confirmed  ED summarization only for phase 1, targeting ~1.2M tokens/month.
- Timeline: Leadership wants to greenlight the pilot by end of May; procurement is aiming to have commercial terms ready by 5/20.
- Security: our InfoSec team will run a standard questionnaire (I'll send it to you tomorrow). They'll need SOC 2, encryption-at-rest details, and an architecture diagram showing how data flows into the VPC.

One risk to flag: Carlos is concerned about integration effort for our billing schema  we'll likely need a short engineering spike to validate the JSON outputs map correctly to our pipeline. Can your solutions architect time-box a 2-day spike?

Next steps from me:
- I'll share the security questionnaire and do the intro to procurement this week.
- Carlos will review the MAP and we'll get back with any changes by next Tuesday (4/12).

Appreciate the quick turnaround  attaching our internal procurement intake URL for your reference: https://nexavante.slack.com/archives/C0123456

 Sophie
Head of Product Operations | NexaVante

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie.grant@nexavante.com>, Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@nexavante.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@nexavante.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T17:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call exec recap & next steps  NexaVante

Great  thanks Sophie. Quick confirmation on our side and a couple of action items for leadership visibility: 

Confirmed
- Solutions architect available to do a 2-day engineering spike to validate JSON mapping (we can schedule 4/19-4/20).
- We'll provide SOC 2 report, DPA draft, and a VPC/on-prem architecture diagram by 4/09.

Executive sponsor summary (for Carlos & leadership)
- Business outcome: Pilot aims to cut clinician summarization time by ~60% and automate billing extraction to reduce manual FTE effort.
- Risk & mitigation: Tail-latency risk  mitigated via dedicated pools + canary routing to a smaller instance size for the pilot. We'll commit to telemetry collection and weekly checkpoints during the pilot window.
- Procurement path: Preferred path is pilot SOW (60-day)  pilot renewal conversion to dedicated capacity contract. Procurement should expect standard MSA + DPA; our commercial lead can prepare a pilot SOW and a one-page commercial summary.
- Escalations: If legal/security need extended time, escalate to me and Laura; for pilot-level SLA exceptions we will engage engineering leadership (Aditya).

Immediate asks
- Sophie/Procurement: Please send over the security questionnaire and any commercial constraints by 4/09.
- Carlos/Leadership: Please confirm pilot success metrics (P95 latency target, accuracy threshold for structured outputs) so we can finalize the MAP.

I'll follow up with the attachments and the MAP in a separate thread and schedule the spike with your engineering contact once you confirm dates.

Thanks  Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
